children: Claros Mortgage Trust reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $32.6 million, down 29.2% from $46.1 million a year earlier, and a net loss of $14.3 million compared with a $9.5 million loss in 3Q 2025. The wider loss reflected lower net interest income and higher expenses.
Revenue was $32.6M, compared with $46.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (29.2%).
Net loss was $14.3M, compared with a $9.5M net loss in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted loss per share was $0.10, compared with $0.07 in the prior-year quarter.
Claros resolved $409.5 million of loan principal during the quarter through repayments, a below-par sale and a discounted payoff.
The company managed eight real estate-owned properties valued at $700.7 million. Multifamily and hotel operations increased property revenue 4% quarter over quarter.
Ten loans totaling $1.55 billion in unpaid principal were rated highest risk. After quarter-end, two of those loans were under sale agreements.
Claros sold a Dallas multifamily property during the first nine months and agreed to sell two hotel properties for $44.5 million, subject to closing conditions.
Management expects further asset resolutions and lender deleveraging, and may sell or restructure loans or take possession of collateral to maximize recovery.
